semantics.clock: Update at positive edge of clk, as explicitly specified.
semantics.reset: Positive edge of areset asynchronously sets state to 2'b01; asserted reset has priority at clock edges.
semantics.training: At each positive clock edge without reset, valid taken increments with saturation; valid not-taken decrements with saturation; invalid holds.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; no initial assignment. Verification establishes known state by asynchronous reset.

verification.oracle: Integer reference derived directly from original saturating-counter rules
verification.sampling: Drive training while clock low; compare after positive clock edge and NBA settling. Check reset off clock edges, reset-held clock edges, and no change at negative edges or reset release.
verification.coverage: All four states with both valid and taken values; repeated saturation, hold, reset during training, and deterministic mixed sequences
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state before the first reset or clock is unspecified; verification makes no assertion about its value.
